what: A sharp mask with a 105° diagonal edge (panel 230%×120%) sweeps from 110% → 0%, so the text wipes in diagonally from the bottom left — each character runs on its own, delayed 0.05s each, .6s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) per character. Plays once when it enters 100px above the screen bottom. With look: block, nothing is split and the whole element (the hero collage panel) is wiped at once (original 2s, delayed .8s).

options.delay: Delay (s) before the first letter (or plate), default 0 — original hero plate .8
options.dur: Seconds for one character (or panel) to be wiped in, default .6 — original brush-script copy 1, hero panel 2 (1.5 below 1100)
options.ease: Curve as four Bézier values in the form ”0.4,0.4,0,1”, default that one
options.on: load plays right after load without waiting to enter the viewport (Hero copy), manual plays when fx:play is sent · default is when it scrolls into view
options.margin: How many px above the screen bottom it must enter to turn on, default 100
options.look: block: Apply the mask to the whole element without splitting it (photo / collage panel)
